description: Use this when the user asks about a specific AAVE asset in detail — e.g. 'Tell me everything about USDC on Ethereum AAVE', 'What are the WETH borrow parameters?', 'What is the liquidation threshold for WBTC collateral?'. Returns full reserve config: current rates, TVL, LTV, liquidation parameters, lifetime stats (total borrows/repayments/liquidations), and token addresses. RATE CONVERSION: divide liquidityRate / variableBorrowRate by 1e27 * 100 for APY %.

symbol.description: Token symbol — case-insensitive (e.g. USDC, WETH, WBTC, DAI, USDT, LINK, AAVE)

name: get_aave_reserve
